headline: Dual Front Escalation: Hebron Attack and Moscow Drone Strikes Mark Regional War Intensification
subheadline: Two Palestinian gunmen killed two Israeli soldiers near Hebron while Ukrainian drones forced all four Moscow airports to suspend operations amid widespread strikes.
lede: A deadly shooting attack near Hebron killed two Israeli soldiers and wounded five others after two Palestinian gunmen targeted civilians on Route 35 before being neutralized in a 20-minute gunbattle. Widespread Geran-5 and Shahhed drones struck targets across Kyiv, Dnipro, and western Ukraine, while Ukrainian drones attacked Moscow, forcing all four major airports to suspend operations. Iran completed deployment of precision missiles in western Iran and drew up plans to target Gulf undersea communications cables if the US and Israel launch another attack. The IDF announced a multi-front defense drill ahead of national elections as the UK launched a 'Be Ready' emergency preparedness campaign urging citizens to stockpile three days of supplies.

sections.title: Drone Strikes Hit Kyiv and Moscow
sections.body: Geran-5 and Shahhed drones struck targets across Kyiv, Dnipro, and western Ukraine, activating air alerts in multiple regions. Ukrainian drones attacked Moscow, forcing all four major airports to suspend operations and triggering evacuations. Russian forces launched coordinated drone and missile attacks on energy infrastructure, causing power outages in occupied Crimea and parts of eastern Ukraine. Air defense systems intercepted or tracked incoming threats over Kyiv, Zhytomyr, and Chernihiv regions throughout the night.

sections.title: Hebron Attack and Iranian Missile Deployment
sections.body: Two Palestinian gunmen opened fire at an Israeli checkpoint near Hebron, killing two soldiers and wounding five others before being killed in a 20-minute gunbattle. Israeli forces launched a raid in the Hebron area following the deadly shooting attack at the checkpoint. Iran completed deployment of precision missiles in western Iran and drew up plans to target undersea communications cables in the Gulf if the US and Israel launch another attack. The IDF announced a multi-front defense drill simulating surprise attacks ahead of national elections.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The Hebron checkpoint attack demonstrates Palestinian militant groups retain lethal operational capability against Israeli military targets in the West Bank. Iran's precision missile deployment in western Iran and plans to target Gulf undersea cables signal readiness to expand conflict beyond traditional battlefields. Cross-border drone activity from Belarus and Russian border regions into northern Ukraine indicates broadening hostilities beyond established frontlines.
